rules: Existing selected-character, session and ban state must be read/locked with combat state mutation in the same durable authority transaction or an explicitly proven equivalent serialized consistency model
No automatic migration in Host and no production schema or DDL claim
SQLite single writer and PostgreSQL lock order must be reviewed and tested independently, with source and restored DB CI

domain_model.action_idempotency: EncounterId+ActorId+ActionId or CastId with exact payload fingerprint
domain_model.hit_idempotency: EncounterId+HitId / TargetId+DeathKey, CAS and unique DB constraint

work_packages.title: 普通攻擊意圖、連段窗與雙層權限
interfaces: AuthorizeBasicAttackAsync(SessionLease, EncounterId, ActorId, TargetId, ActionId, ExpectedRevision, CancellationToken)
acceptance: Transactional lease/selected-role/ban validity and Encounter ownership revalidated at the authoritative write boundary, not a pre-flight IsCurrentAsync snapshot
Actor and target must share ACTIVE Encounter and current mock revision; Client never supplies a success, combo proof, damage number or privileged tick
Server-owned config pins valid action/combo windows; a deterministic internal clock/tick and bounded history prevent stale/early/future input
Idempotency identity scoped to encounter/actor/action; duplicate same payload returns unchanged result only after fresh authorization; collision differing payload rejects
An ActionRequested does not cause damage or mission completion; accepted action vs committed animation/hit separate
work_packages.native_evidence_required: T10/T02/T04 direction-specific Client attack producer, combo/cancel temporal windows, Server event/accept/reject and hit attribution

work_packages.title: 技能施放與資源冷卻原子預留/定案
interfaces: ReserveSkillCastAsync(SessionLease, EncounterId, SkillKeyMock, CastId, ExpectedRevision, CancellationToken)
CommitOrCancelMockCastAsync(SessionLease, EncounterId, CastId, Resolution, ExpectedRevision, CancellationToken)
acceptance: Skill availability, actor/owner, current simulated skill-state, cooldown and resource are checked under one aggregate revision with exact current lease and account moderation
Reserve/commit/cancel lifecycle is specified, including interrupted cast, expiry, disconnect, stale cast, reorder; resource refund policy is PROPOSED and needs maintainer approval
Repeated CastId cannot double deduct costs, cooldown or spawn hit; same key with changed parameters is conflict, not success
Use Server mock monotonic tick for cooldown; wall clock and Client timestamp never determine ready/expiry or reveal cross-session bypass
No actual KR skill ID, effect, cost, cooldown/cast milliseconds or error/opcode derived from these fixtures
work_packages.native_evidence_required: T11/T10/T04/T02 skill identity, input/cancel, exact available skills, resource/cooldown and result consumer with connection/state

work_packages.title: 命中/傷害/死亡唯一提交與計算權威
interfaces: ResolveMockHitAsync(EncounterId, ActionOrCastId, HitId, ActorId, TargetId, ExpectedRevision, CancellationToken)
acceptance: Only authoritative accepted action/cast and validated mock hit predicate can propose damage; no Client-submitted HP/death/victory trusted
Validate both actors same encounter, alive, distance/range, phase, collision/target eligibility, action timing and no friendly-fire assumptions without configured fixture
Use bounded, checked integer fixed-point damage rules, clamp health within 0..maxHealth and reject invalid/overflow; mock formula is explicitly NOT original Tartaros
HitId and death key unique across retries/workers; one atomic transaction updates HP, death-state, target/encounter revisions and dedup record
ActorDeath is a domain fact passed to later S27-W05 objectives; does not directly mark Scenario14, Quest14 or tutorial completed
work_packages.native_evidence_required: T12/T08/T10/T11 real damage/result consumers, authority, hit/death sequencing, actual numbers and actor ownership

work_packages.title: 取消/斷線/重放/崩潰恢復及 W05 接口邊界
acceptance: Cancel vs committed hit must have a single deterministic winner under CAS; late cancel cannot restore already committed damage or double refund
Reconnect/ban/unban/renew revokes previous lease-authorized action mutation; no background worker may bypass account/Session/Encounter fencing when committing a player-owned action
Crash after cost reservation, before hit, after hit-before-outbox must reconcile exactly once with persisted action/cast/hit/death event keys
Separate domain at-most-once state mutation from at-least-once Outbox notification and original Client compatibility, no claim of exactly-once TCP
Handoff only a verified ActorDeath or combat event to S27-W05 objective; do not auto-settle Scenario14/Quest14/Quest16 from Combat
work_packages.native_evidence_required: T10/T11/T12/T14/T16 action cancellation, death/hit notification and Scenario14 objective crossing requires verified original Client/Server association
